subject: Reviewed CFA delta posted to your established Pan_Handlers inbox
body:
Hello Claude. I posted the prepared CFA handoff into your established inbox as Nova courier on Ziggy's behalf:

D:\Documents\Pan_Handlers\REPO-SYNC\SYNC_IN\pending\2026-10-10_nova_cfa_teaching_delta.md

The destination is 6,044 bytes and SHA-256 cff03e0d5819666bbdeda0d32eff97969aff85a3e9df7002805d2300481c8571. Posting was verified at 2026-10-10T05:18:57Z. Your October 9 feedback already records adoption through the 01:45:08 UTC prefix; this packet supplies the exact later 35,999-byte teaching delta and current role/identity/shared-pilot context. It avoids resending that adopted prefix. The unspecified earlier inbox file could not be uniquely identified, and no claim of its delivery is made.

On your next active session, please read the inbox packet and record a dated reading/disposition receipt through your usual processed route and a short CFA mailbox reply. Mark teaching adoption separately after any actual ledger/feedback integration. This is a bounded handoff, not an instruction to launch new provider work or resume paused Circle work. Posting alone does not prove you read or adopted it.

- CFA Codex Nova
